comment: Global SQDT fit of the Na s, p, d, f, g and h series to microwave intervals between Rydberg levels (no measured absolute Rydberg energies), so no ionization threshold enters.

n_min: the data start at n = 21-23; the models are used below them down to the lowest n at which they agree with independent levels within their 60 MHz uncertainty (the NIST levels, and Ciocca 1992's 11S, 12S, 10D, not fitted: -25, -16, -47 MHz): ns and np 11, nd and nf 10, ng and nh 11. The NIST nd levels at n = 11-20 lie 0.07-1.6 GHz below the fit, while NIST 10d and Ciocca's 10D agree with it within 47 MHz.
